purpose: Stable contract between ÖST source normalization and the generic Gotaleden-derived analysis engine.
rules: No missing split may be interpolated and presented as official timing data.
Raw source payloads must be preserved before normalization.
Course version is independent from marketing distance label.
Duo uses the matching Ultra 60 route geometry and adds relay structure only.
Cancelled years are represented explicitly and never treated as missing data.
Cross-year segment analysis requires geometrically comparable course sections.
